Load Project

Do you want to merge this project with what is already here?
Merge adds the loaded Casing and Drill String designs (with their Well Drilling and Well Testing data), Geology, Testing Zones and Bits Records to the existing ones; the BOP stack is only loaded if the current one is empty.
Replace first clears everything (all saved designs, the current drawings, BOP stack, Geology, Testing Zones and Bits Records) — this cannot be undone.

Drill String Designs Manager

Select a design below, then act on it — or save the current working design into the list. Designs are stored locally in this browser only.

Design Properties

Drill String Components

Components stack contiguously top to bottom — each one's Top is locked to the previous one's Bottom. Drag a row to reorder, resize with Length. Only the first component's Top is free (it anchors the whole string). Total Depth follows the stack automatically. TJ Connection and Collar Size selections set OD/ID automatically per API Spec 7.

Confirm

Volumes

Three separate tables: Drill String, Open Hole and Casing. Open Hole and Casing are broken down by the drill string component inside each interval: Hole / Casing Volume is the full volume of that interval, Annular Volume is that volume minus the pipe (the whole volume where there is no drill string). Capacity is in litres per metre.

Click "Use" to apply a spec to the currently selected Drill Pipe / HWDP, or add your own custom entries below. Adjusted Weight includes the tool joint's contribution, averaged over joint length — it's the real weight per foot the string carries, not just the pipe body.
